one_line: Usurper-king of Bactria whose hard-won rule split the Greco-Bactrian and Indo-Greek realms.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, tall and broad-shouldered with a seasoned soldier’s build.
appearance.face: Long, strong-jawed face with a prominent straight nose, deep-set grey eyes under heavy brows, olive complexion weathered by sun, trimmed short beard and mustache, default expression a focused, stern calm that shifts into intense determination in battle.
appearance.hair: Thick, slightly wavy dark brown hair cut short over the ears and nape, brushed forward in gentle locks along the forehead; wears a simple bronze Attic-style helmet with a low ridge and short cheek-pieces, usually pushed back so his fringe shows.
appearance.costume: Over a white linen chiton with short sleeves, he wears a sleeveless scale cuirass of overlapping bronze scales with a dull metallic sheen, edged at the armholes and neck with a narrow crimson leather trim; a long, heavy crimson wool cloak (chlamys) fastened at his right shoulder with a round bronze brooch hangs to mid-calf, usually thrown back to free his sword arm; a wide brown leather belt with simple bronze studs cinches the waist and supports a scabbard; he has knee-length off-white linen kilt-like pteryges under the cuirass, bare lower arms wrapped with brown leather bracers, and sturdy brown leather boots laced up the front to mid-calf, dusty from campaign; for subtle regional flair, a narrow patterned border in dark blue and white runs along the cloak’s edge, echoing simple geometric step motifs seen in Bactria.
appearance.signature: A long, straight iron spear with a leaf-shaped bronze spearhead and a smooth ash-wood shaft, its butt capped with bronze, carried in his right hand and often planted beside him like a portable standard of command.

ref_desc: Eucratides Megas is a tall, broad-shouldered man in his early 40s with an olive long-jawed face, short wavy dark brown hair under a simple bronze Attic helmet, trimmed beard, wearing a white chiton, bronze scale cuirass, crimson-edged chlamys, leather belt and boots, and carrying a long iron spear with a bronze head in a crimson, bronze, white, dark brown and dark blue palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Eucratides Megas: a tall, broad-shouldered man in his early 40s with an olive complexion, long strong jaw, deep-set grey eyes, prominent straight nose, heavy brows and a trimmed short beard and mustache, his thick slightly wavy dark brown hair cut short over the ears and brushed forward at the forehead, wearing a simple bronze Attic helmet with a low ridge and short cheek-pieces pushed back so his fringe shows; dress him in a white linen short-sleeved chiton under a sleeveless bronze scale cuirass edged with narrow crimson leather trim, a long crimson wool cloak fastened at the right shoulder with a round bronze brooch and hanging to mid-calf with a dark blue and white geometric border, a wide brown leather belt with bronze studs, knee-length off-white linen pteryges, brown leather bracers on his forearms, and sturdy brown leather boots laced to mid-calf, slightly dusty, and place in his right hand a long straight iron spear with a leaf-shaped bronze spearhead and bronze-capped butt, posed calmly but ready, clearly showing all colors in a restrained palette of crimson red, bronze, white, dark brown and dark blue.
